prompt: Create a dynamic vertical anime street-art illustration of a cheerful pink-haired graffiti girl painting a huge butterfly mural on a tall rough concrete wall. Use an extreme low-angle perspective from near the ground, with one white platform sneaker stepping toward the viewer and the character towering heroically in the frame. The girl has very long flowing rose-pink hair streaming to the right, bright green eyes, a joyful open-mouthed smile, and a black ribbon accessory in her hair. She wears an oversized cropped black T-shirt tied with ribbon details, loose light-blue wide-leg jeans with white lace-up side seams, and chunky white platform sneakers. She holds 2 spray cans: one raised high above her head spraying a cloud of sparkling paint, and one gripped near her hip. Show 1 giant butterfly mural behind her, spanning almost the entire wall, with delicate black veined wings filled with dripping hot pink and turquoise graffiti paint, splatters, sketchy outlines, and wet vertical paint runs. Include exactly 8 spray cans total: 2 in her hands, 1 large blurred can in the extreme lower-left foreground with a pink nozzle, and 5 upright cans lined along the lower-right floor edge. Add exactly 5 small glowing butterfly silhouettes around the right side of the mural and lower background. The ground is splattered with pink and teal paint, glossy and reflective. Lighting is magical and energetic, with glittering particles, soft pink-white glow around the spray mist, crisp anime linework, highly detailed fabric folds and hair strands, painterly graffiti texture, shallow depth of field in the foreground, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张动态的竖屏动漫街头艺术插画，画面中 一位开朗的粉发涂鸦女孩 正在高大的粗糙混凝土墙上绘制一幅巨大的蝴蝶壁画。采用从地面附近的极低角度透视，一只白色厚底运动鞋向观众迈出，角色在画面中显得高大且富有英雄气概。女孩留着极长的飘逸 玫瑰粉色 秀发，发丝向右飘动，拥有一双明亮的绿色眼睛、开怀大笑的表情，发间系着黑色丝带配饰。她身穿一件带有丝带细节的超大款短款黑色 T 恤，搭配宽松的浅蓝色阔腿牛仔裤（侧边有白色系带），脚踩厚底白色运动鞋。她手持 2 罐喷漆：一罐高举过头顶，喷洒出一团闪烁的漆雾；另一罐握在腰间。她身后是一幅巨大的蝴蝶壁画，几乎覆盖了整面墙壁，精致的黑色脉络翅膀上填满了滴落的 亮粉色和绿松石色 涂鸦颜料，伴有飞溅效果、粗犷的轮廓线以及湿润的垂直流漆。画面中总共包含 8 罐喷漆：2 罐在她手中，1 罐巨大的模糊喷漆罐位于左下角前景，5 罐直立排列在右下方的地面边缘。在壁画右侧及背景下方添加 5 只发光的小蝴蝶剪影。地面上溅满了粉色和青色的颜料，呈现出光亮且反光的效果。光影充满魔幻与活力，带有闪烁的微粒，喷雾周围环绕着柔和的粉白色光晕，线条清晰，衣褶与发丝细节丰富，具有绘画感的涂鸦质感，前景采用浅景深效果，无文字，无水印。
